summary.goal: Implement the full REST API layer for cultivate as an Express router factory: createCultivateRouter(deps). Provides CRUD for greenhouses, signals (including link/dismiss actions), clusters (read-only), sources, presets catalog, document ingestion with status tracking, recommendations, filter rules, dead letter management, webhooks, and an SSE endpoint. All request/response bodies validated with Zod schemas.

acceptance_criteria.description: createCultivateRouter(deps) returns an Express Router with all endpoints mounted
Greenhouse CRUD: POST/GET/GET:id/PUT/DELETE /greenhouses
Signal CRUD + actions: GET/GET:id /signals, POST /signals/:id/link, POST /signals/:id/dismiss
Cluster read: GET /clusters, GET /clusters/:id (with signals)
Source CRUD: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /sources
Presets catalog: GET /presets returns all registered source presets
Ingestion: POST /ingest (file upload), GET /ingest/:id/status
Recommendations: GET /recommendations?greenhouse_id=
Filter rules: GET/PUT /filter-rules
Dead letter: GET /dead-letter, POST /dead-letter/:id/replay, POST /dead-letter/replay-all, DELETE /dead-letter/:id
SSE endpoint: GET /events streams all cultivate SSE events
All request bodies validated with Zod; validation errors return 422 with details

steps.title: Implement createCultivateRouter factory
steps.description: Create src/api/router.ts. Implement createCultivateRouter(deps) that receives dependencies (storage, pipeline, queues, recommender, sse broadcaster, tuner client, presets registry, dead letter manager) and returns an Express Router. Set up JSON body parsing, Zod validation middleware pattern (validate request body against schema, return 422 on failure), and mount all sub-routers. Export the factory function from the package.

acceptance_criteria.description: Factory receives all dependencies via injection
Zod validation middleware returns 422 with field-level error details
All sub-routers mounted at correct paths

steps.title: Add Greenhouse CRUD endpoints
steps.description: Create src/api/handlers/greenhouses.ts. Implement: POST /greenhouses (create with name, description, mode, keyword filters, source_ids — Zod validated), GET /greenhouses (list all), GET /greenhouses/:id (get by id with signal/cluster counts), PUT /greenhouses/:id (update fields), DELETE /greenhouses/:id (soft delete, check no active signals). Use @plannr/errors for NotFoundError, BadRequestError.

acceptance_criteria.description: All 5 CRUD operations implemented and Zod-validated
GET by id includes signal and cluster counts
Delete checks for active signals before removal

steps.title: Add Signal CRUD + link/dismiss endpoints
steps.description: Create src/api/handlers/signals.ts. Implement: GET /signals (list with pagination, filtering by greenhouse_id, status, cluster_id, date range), GET /signals/:id (full signal with provenance), POST /signals/:id/link (link signal to plan — sets linked_plan_id, records Tuner outcome), POST /signals/:id/dismiss (dismiss signal — records Tuner outcome, updates status). Link and dismiss actions trigger Tuner outcome recording via the injected tuner client.

acceptance_criteria.description: Signal listing supports pagination and filtering by greenhouse, status, cluster, date
Link action sets linked_plan_id and records Tuner boost outcome
Dismiss action records Tuner dampen outcome

steps.title: Add Cluster read endpoints
steps.description: Create src/api/handlers/clusters.ts. Implement: GET /clusters (list with filtering by greenhouse_id, trend, min signal count, sorted by signal_count or velocity), GET /clusters/:id (full cluster with its signals included). Clusters are read-only in the API — they are created and managed by the pipeline and recluster system.

acceptance_criteria.description: Cluster listing supports greenhouse, trend, and min signal count filters
GET by id includes the cluster's signals
No write operations exposed for clusters

steps.title: Add Source CRUD + Presets catalog endpoints
steps.description: Create src/api/handlers/sources.ts. Implement: POST /sources (create source from config or preset — Zod validated, encrypts auth credentials), GET /sources (list with health status), PUT /sources/:id (update config, re-encrypt if auth changed), DELETE /sources/:id (disable and remove). GET /presets returns the full presets catalog with all 30+ source presets organized by tier.

acceptance_criteria.description: Source creation encrypts auth credentials before storage
Source listing includes current health status
Presets catalog returns all presets organized by tier

steps.title: Add Ingestion endpoints (upload + status)
steps.description: Create src/api/handlers/ingestion.ts. Implement: POST /ingest (accepts file upload via multipart form data, creates IngestionJob, enqueues ingest-document job, returns job id), GET /ingest/:id/status (returns IngestionJob with progress — total_chunks, processed_chunks, status). File upload uses Express multer middleware or similar for multipart handling.

acceptance_criteria.description: File upload creates IngestionJob and enqueues processing
Status endpoint returns progress with chunk counts
Multipart form data handling for file uploads

steps.title: Add Recommendations + Filter Rules + Dead Letter endpoints
steps.description: Create src/api/handlers/recommendations.ts, src/api/handlers/filter-rules.ts, and src/api/handlers/dead-letter.ts. Recommendations: GET /recommendations?greenhouse_id= (returns cached or fresh recommendations). Filter rules: GET /filter-rules (list all with effectiveness stats), PUT /filter-rules (bulk update enabled/disabled states). Dead letter: GET /dead-letter (list with pagination), POST /dead-letter/:id/replay (re-enqueue single job), POST /dead-letter/replay-all (re-enqueue all), DELETE /dead-letter/:id (discard).

acceptance_criteria.description: Recommendations endpoint supports greenhouse filtering
Filter rules support bulk enable/disable updates
Dead letter supports list, replay, replay-all, and discard

steps.title: Add SSE endpoint (GET /events) wiring
steps.description: Create src/api/handlers/events.ts. Implement GET /events as an SSE endpoint. Set appropriate headers (Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, Connection: keep-alive). Wire the SSE broadcaster to write events to connected clients. Support optional greenhouse_id query param to filter events to a specific greenhouse. Handle client disconnect cleanup. Each SSE event includes type (signal:new, cluster:trending, etc.) and JSON data payload.

acceptance_criteria.description: SSE headers correctly set for event streaming
Events filterable by greenhouse_id query parameter
Client disconnect properly cleaned up
All SSE event types propagated to connected clients
